Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
NRA: From the FAQ (linked to WW:VTES site):

************************************************
The new base rules incorporate a variation of the No Repeat Actions
special floor
rule from the V:EKN tournament rules. Instead of restricting repeats by
(a sometimes
difficult to define) type, a minion cannot

* bleed twice in a turn
* take a political action twice in a turn
* use the same action card twice in a turn
* take the action allowed by a card in play twice in a turn

by the new rules, with no restrictions on, for example, hunting or
equipping
(assuming the minion can untap, of course). The last item (card in play)
includes
any special ability the minion may have.

As equipment cards (and retainers, and allies) all count as action
cards, you may
take multiple equip minion actions with the same minion on any given
turn,
but they cannot be the same piece of equipment.
You can: Equip with a Sport Bike, Untap, Equip with a .44 Magnum.
You cannot: Equip with a .44 Magnum, Untap, Equip with a second .44
Magnum.
************************************************

I can't find any of this in the online rulebook. Could someone point me
to it?

It appears to say that you cannot equip 2 .44 Magnums with the same
Minion in the same turn (though presumably you can if you have another
way of getting the second? -eg Magic of the Smith) but you can get two
of the same retainer (eg 2 raven Spies) on the same turn. Is this
correct? If so, why the distinction?

The rulebook is quite clear about this one: You it you are blocked
trying to come out of torpor, you don't burn the 2 blood. Did you used
to have to burn the 2 blood to attempt to leave torpor even if you were
blocked in the attempt? (someone was quite sure last night that that was
how it worked so I'm wondering why)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Timlagor wrote:
> NRA: From the FAQ (linked to WW:VTES site):

> I can't find any of this in the online rulebook. Could someone point me
> to it?

6.1.1
6.1.6
6.1.7

> It appears to say that you cannot equip 2 .44 Magnums with the same
> Minion in the same turn (though presumably you can if you have another
> way of getting the second? -eg Magic of the Smith) but you can get two
> of the same retainer (eg 2 raven Spies) on the same turn. Is this
> correct? If so, why the distinction?

No.
The prohibition on taking the same action card action prohibits taking two
"employ" actions via the "Raven Spy" action card.

> The rulebook is quite clear about this one: You it you are blocked
> trying to come out of torpor, you don't burn the 2 blood. Did you used
> to have to burn the 2 blood to attempt to leave torpor even if you were
> blocked in the attempt? (someone was quite sure last night that that was
> how it worked so I'm wondering why)

Back in Jyhad (1994), yes. That changed in 1995.

--

Messages.Author: Ulugh Beg II
Messages.Body:
Related:

Can you try to diablerize a vampire twice per turn? It is technically an
action allowed by a card in play (the torporized vamp). If so, can you
try it twice with the same vampire?

Just wondering...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ulugh Beg II wrote:
> Can you try to diablerize a vampire twice per turn? It is technically an

Yes.

> action allowed by a card in play (the torporized vamp). If so, can you

That's like saying "hunt" is technically an action allowed by a card in
play (the hunting vampire). No vampire's special text says "When I'm in
torpor, any ready vampire may diablerize me as a (D) action".

> try it twice with the same vampire?

Yes, if he untaps somehow and isn't prohbited (e.g., with Change of
Target's prohibition).
